transcript.text: Can you tell me more about the bus-pass renewal web app you developed for your college transport office?

I'm a final-year BTech student in computer science at a private engineering college in Coimbatore. My main project was a bus-pass renewal app for our college transport office. Before that, students stood in a queue for about two hours to renew. I built the form and payment-confirmation flow, and in the pilot semester about 900 students used it. I now want an MBA because I enjoy deciding what to build more than writing the code, and I don't have the business training for that.
What technologies and tools did you use to build this bus-pass renewal web app?
transcript.anchor_quote: I built the form and payment-confirmation flow

transcript.text: I would say my project was a very scalable and innovative solution that leveraged the latest technologies to create value for all stakeholders. It was a great learning experience and the impact was significant.
Could you specify which technologies and tools you actually used in building the bus-pass renewal web app?
transcript.anchor_quote: my project was a very scalable and innovative solution that leveraged the latest technologies

transcript.text: I don't remember the exact number of bugs we fixed after the pilot. I never kept a proper log, so I can't give a figure.
